title: Comparison of Epidemiology, Risk Factors, Clinical Presentation and Outcomes of COVID-19 and Seasonal Influenza Among Hospitalized Swiss Children: A Nationwide Prospective Surveillance Study.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Although many children infected with severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus type 2 (SARS-CoV-2) or seasonal influenza virus experience a mild course of disease, both infections can lead to hospitalization and, in a subset of children, severe disease requiring intensive care unit (ICU) admission for respiratory or cardiac support. To compare the epidemiology, risk factors, clinical presentation and outcomes of children hospitalized with COVID-19 or seasonal influenza, and to identify factors associated with severe disease. METHODS: Data were collected prospectively within a nationwide surveillance system across Swiss hospitals between December 2018 and November 2023. A comparative analysis was performed among children and adolescents (<18 years) hospitalized with laboratory-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 or seasonal influenza infection. SARS-CoV-2 data were analyzed according to four time periods defined by the predominantly circulating virus variant: wild type (T1), Alpha (T2), Delta (T3) and Omicron (T4). Influenza data were analyzed across two periods: "pre-COVID" (December 2018 to April 30, 2020) and "during COVID" (May 1, 2020, to November 30, 2023). RESULTS: Of 4662 included children, 3132 (67.2%) were hospitalized with SARS-CoV-2 infection and 1530 (32.8%) with influenza. Age distribution differed by virus and period (P < 0.001): infants accounted for one-third to almost half of SARS-CoV-2 admissions (32.2%-46.7%), with adolescents also contributing notably during T1 (22.7%), whereas toddlers and school-aged children were more frequently hospitalized with influenza infection. Fever, cough and rhinitis were the most common symptoms for both viruses. Among periods with symptom data available, fever was less frequent during SARS-CoV-2 T4 (47.3%) than during earlier SARS-CoV-2 waves (62.8% in T1, 55.7% in T2 and 64.9% in T3) and was also less frequent among children with influenza during the COVID period (26.0%). Anosmia was recorded only among children with SARS-CoV-2 infection (most often during T1: 1.2%; P < 0.001). Proportions of severe symptoms were also similar, except respiratory distress being more common during T4 (12.6%) and with influenza (18.1%; P = 0.02). Acute respiratory distress syndrome was recorded only among children hospitalized with influenza and not among those hospitalized with SARS-CoV-2. ICU admissions were highest during influenza seasons (pre-COVID 10.5% and during COVID 11.8%) compared with 5.0% to 10.3% with SARS-CoV-2 (P = 0.001). Complications were more frequent in children with seasonal influenza (P < 0.001), most commonly lobar pneumonia, which occurred in up to 20% of children with influenza. During T3, deconditioning syndrome was more frequently reported (5.6%) than in other periods. Antibiotic use was higher in children with influenza (40.7% vs. Factors independently associated with severe disease were neurological, cardiovascular and other underlying conditions in children with COVID-19, and neurological and respiratory conditions in children with influenza. CONCLUSIONS: Among hospitalized children with laboratory-confirmed infection, influenza was associated with more frequent ICU admission, complications, antibiotic use and respiratory support than SARS-CoV-2. Although underlying conditions were associated with an increased risk for severe disease, most children had no preexisting underlying conditions. These findings support consideration of broader pediatric influenza vaccination strategies beyond traditional high-risk groups and the need for ongoing surveillance to monitor evolving disease patterns and inform clinical and public health decisions.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the public-health burden of two common respiratory viruses in children by asking why comparative data on epidemiology, risk factors, clinical presentation and outcomes were needed for hospitalized cases of COVID-19 versus seasonal influenza.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A nationwide prospective surveillance study was conducted across Swiss hospitals from December 2018 to November 2023, enrolling children and adolescents under 18 years hospitalized with laboratory-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 or seasonal influenza infection.
analysis.methods: SARS-CoV-2 cases were stratified by four variant-defined time periods (wild type, Alpha, Delta, Omicron), while influenza cases were split into pre-COVID and during-COVID periods; data were collected prospectively within a national surveillance system.
analysis.main_results: Among 4662 children, 3132 (67.2%) were hospitalized with SARS-CoV-2 and 1530 (32.8%) with influenza; infants comprised one-third to nearly half of SARS-CoV-2 admissions, whereas toddlers and school-aged children dominated influenza admissions.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Influenza was associated with higher ICU admission (10.5–11.8% vs 5.0–10.3%), more complications (e.g., lobar pneumonia up to 20%), greater antibiotic use (40.7% vs unspecified lower rate), and more respiratory support than SARS-CoV-2 in hospitalized children.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings support expanding pediatric influenza vaccination beyond traditional high-risk groups and maintaining robust surveillance to guide clinical and public-health decisions as viral variants and patterns evolve.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s observational design and reliance on routine surveillance data limit causal inference and generalizability; evidence strength is assessed as moderate due to potential unmeasured confounding and incomplete symptom documentation in some periods.

analysis.summary_en: This nationwide prospective surveillance study in Swiss children under 18 years compared hospitalized cases of COVID-19 and seasonal influenza from December 2018 to November 2023. Among 4662 laboratory-confirmed admissions, 67.2% were due to SARS-CoV-2 and 32.8% to influenza. Infants accounted for one-third to nearly half of SARS-CoV-2 admissions, while toddlers and school-aged children were more frequently hospitalized with influenza. Fever, cough and rhinitis were common in both infections, but fever was less frequent during the Omicron wave and the COVID period for influenza. Anosmia occurred only with SARS-CoV-2, whereas acute respiratory distress syndrome and lobar pneumonia (up to 20%) were recorded only among influenza cases. ICU admissions were higher for influenza (10.5–11.8%) than for SARS-CoV-2 (5.0–10.3%), and antibiotic use was greater in influenza (40.7%). Underlying neurological, cardiovascular and respiratory conditions were independently associated with severe disease for both viruses. The authors conclude that influenza in hospitalized children is associated with more severe outcomes than SARS-CoV-2 and recommend broader pediatric influenza vaccination and ongoing surveillance.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究通过询问为什么需要针对住院病例的 COVID-19 与 季节性流感 的 流行病学、危险因素、临床表现和结果的比较数据,解决了两种常见呼吸道病毒对儿童的公共卫生负担。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2018 年 12 月至 2023 年 11 月,瑞士多家医院进行了一项全国性前瞻性 监测 研究,招募了因实验室确诊的 SARS-CoV-2 或 季节性流感 感染而住院的 18 岁以下儿童和青少年。
elements_zh.methods: SARS-CoV-2病例按四个变体定义的时间段(野生型、Alpha、Delta、Omicron)进行分层,而流感病例则分为新冠肺炎前和新冠肺炎期间;数据是在国家 监测 系统中前瞻性收集的。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 4662 名儿童中,3132 名(67.2%)因 SARS-CoV-2 住院,1530 名(32.8%)因流感住院;婴儿占 SARS-CoV-2 入院人数的三分之一到近一半,而幼儿和学龄儿童则主要是流感入院人数。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在住院儿童中,与 SARS-CoV-2 相比,流感与 ICU 入住率较高(10.5-11.8% vs 5.0-10.3%)、更多并发症(例如,大叶性肺炎高达 20%)、更多抗生素使用(40.7% vs 未明确的较低比率)以及更多呼吸支持相关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持将儿科流感 疫苗接种 扩大到传统高危人群之外,并保持稳健的 监测,以随着病毒变异和模式的演变指导临床和公共卫生决策。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的观察设计和对常规 监测 数据的依赖限制了因果推断和普遍性;由于某些时期可能存在未测量的混杂因素和不完整的症状记录,证据强度被评估为中等。

title_zh: 住院瑞士儿童中 COVID-19 和 季节性流感 的 流行病学、危险因素、临床表现和结果的比较:全国范围的前瞻性 监测 研究。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Although many children infected with severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus type 2 (SARS-CoV-2) or seasonal influenza virus experience a mild course of disease, both infections can lead to hospitalization and, in a subset of children, severe disease requiring intensive care unit (ICU) admission for respiratory or cardiac support. To compare the epidemiology, risk factors, clinical presentation and outcomes of children hospitalized with COVID-19 or seasonal influenza, and to identify factors associated with severe disease. METHODS: Data were collected prospectively within a nationwide surveillance system across Swiss hospitals between December 2018 and November 2023. A comparative analysis was performed among children and adolescents (<18 years) hospitalized with laboratory-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 or seasonal influenza infection. SARS-CoV-2 data were analyzed according to four time periods defined by the predominantly circulating virus variant: wild type (T1), Alpha (T2), Delta (T3) and Omicron (T4). Influenza data were analyzed across two periods: "pre-COVID" (December 2018 to April 30, 2020) and "during COVID" (May 1, 2020, to November 30, 2023). RESULTS: Of 4662 included children, 3132 (67.2%) were hospitalized with SARS-CoV-2 infection and 1530 (32.8%) with influenza. Age distribution differed by virus and period (P < 0.001): infants accounted for one-third to almost half of SARS-CoV-2 admissions (32.2%-46.7%), with adolescents also contributing notably during T1 (22.7%), whereas toddlers and school-aged children were more frequently hospitalized with influenza infection. Fever, cough and rhinitis were the most common symptoms for both viruses. Among periods with symptom data available, fever was less frequent during SARS-CoV-2 T4 (47.3%) than during earlier SARS-CoV-2 waves (62.8% in T1, 55.7% in T2 and 64.9% in T3) and was also less frequent among children with influenza during the COVID period (26.0%). Anosmia was recorded only among children with SARS-CoV-2 infection (most often during T1: 1.2%; P < 0.001). Proportions of severe symptoms were also similar, except respiratory distress being more common during T4 (12.6%) and with influenza (18.1%; P = 0.02). Acute respiratory distress syndrome was recorded only among children hospitalized with influenza and not among those hospitalized with SARS-CoV-2. ICU admissions were highest during influenza seasons (pre-COVID 10.5% and during COVID 11.8%) compared with 5.0% to 10.3% with SARS-CoV-2 (P = 0.001). Complications were more frequent in children with seasonal influenza (P < 0.001), most commonly lobar pneumonia, which occurred in up to 20% of children with influenza. During T3, deconditioning syndrome was more frequently reported (5.6%) than in other periods. Antibiotic use was higher in children with influenza (40.7% vs. Factors independently associated with severe disease were neurological, cardiovascular and other underlying conditions in children with COVID-19, and neurological and respiratory conditions in children with influenza. CONCLUSIONS: Among hospitalized children with laboratory-confirmed infection, influenza was associated with more frequent ICU admission, complications, antibiotic use and respiratory support than SARS-CoV-2. Although underlying conditions were associated with an increased risk for severe disease, most children had no preexisting underlying conditions. These findings support consideration of broader pediatric influenza vaccination strategies beyond traditional high-risk groups and the need for ongoing surveillance to monitor evolving disease patterns and inform clinical and public health decisions.
abstract_zh: 背景:虽然许多感染 2 型严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒 (SARS-CoV-2) 或 季节性流感 病毒的儿童病程较轻,但这两种感染都可能导致住院治疗,并且在一部分儿童中,病情严重,需要入住重症监护病房 (ICU) 接受呼吸或心脏支持。比较因 COVID-19 或 季节性流感 住院的儿童的 流行病学、危险因素、临床表现和结果,并确定与严重疾病相关的因素。方法:2018 年 12 月至 2023 年 11 月期间,在瑞士各医院的全国 监测 系统中前瞻性收集数据。对因实验室确诊的 SARS-CoV-2 或 季节性流感 感染而住院的儿童和青少年(<18 岁)进行比较分析。SARS-CoV-2 数据根据主要传播的病毒变体定义的四个时间段进行分析:野生型 (T1)、Alpha (T2)、Delta (T3) 和 Omicron (T4)。流感数据分两个时期进行分析:“新冠疫情前”(2018年12月至2020年4月30日)和“新冠疫情期间”(2020年5月1日至2023年11月30日)。结果:在 4662 名儿童中,3132 名(67.2%)因 SARS-CoV-2 感染住院,1530 名(32.8%)因流感住院。年龄分布因病毒和时期而异(P < 0.001):婴儿占 SARS-CoV-2 入院人数的三分之一到近一半(32.2%-46.7%),青少年在 T1 期间的贡献也显着(22.7%),而幼儿和学龄儿童因流感感染住院的情况更为常见。发烧、咳嗽和鼻炎是这两种病毒最常见的症状。在有症状数据的时期中,SARS-CoV-2 T4 期间的发烧频率 (47.3%) 低于早期 SARS-CoV-2 波期间的发烧频率(T1 中为 62.8%,T2 中为 55.7%,T3 中为 64.9%),并且在 COVID 期间感染流感的儿童中发烧频率也较低(26.0%)。仅在感染 SARS-CoV-2 的儿童中记录到嗅觉丧失(最常见于 T1:1.2%;P < 0.001)。严重症状的比例也相似,但呼​​吸窘迫在 T4 期间(12.6%)和流感期间(18.1%;P = 0.02)更常见。仅在因流感住院的儿童中记录了急性呼吸窘迫综合征,而在因 SARS-CoV-2 住院的儿童中未记录到。流感季节期间 ICU 入院率最高(新冠肺炎前为 10.5%,新冠肺炎期间为 11.8%),而 SARS-CoV-2 则为 5.0% 至 10.3%(P = 0.001)。季节性流感 儿童的并发症更为常见 (P < 0.001),最常见的是大叶性肺炎,高达 20% 的流感儿童发生这种情况。在 T3 期间,与其他时期相比,失调综合征的报告频率更高(5.6%)。流感儿童的抗生素使用率较高(40.7%,而与严重疾病独立相关的因素是 COVID-19 儿童的神经系统、心血管和其他基础疾病,以及流感儿童的神经系统和呼吸系统疾病。结论:在实验室确诊感染的住院儿童中,与 SARS-CoV-2 相比,流感与更频繁的 ICU 入住、并发症、抗生素使用和呼吸支持相关。尽管基础疾病与严重疾病风险增加相关,但大多数儿童没有预先存在的基础疾病这些发现支持考虑超越传统高危人群的更广泛的儿科流感 疫苗接种 策略,以及持续使用 监测 来监测不断变化的疾病模式并为临床和公共卫生决策提供信息的必要性。

title: Deciphering influenza B virus-derived peptides and their presentation by HLA class I molecules.
abstract: Despite influenza vaccines being widely available, influenza still causes significant morbidity and mortality annually. Vaccines typically induce humoral-mediated protection against rapidly mutating surface glycoproteins, necessitating that they be updated and administered each year. In contrast, CD8+ T cells, which can control and clear viral infections, can recognise more conserved viral epitopes. Therefore, there is considerable interest in understanding CD8+ T cell responses to influenza virus for the development of future vaccines and therapeutics. Although Alphainfluenzavirus influenzae (FLUAV) and Betainfluenzavirus influenzae (FLUBV) co-circulate in humans and both contribute to seasonal epidemics, there is limited data regarding CD8+ T cell responses to FLUBV. This knowledge gap spans both immunological and molecular insights. In the present review, we summarise the current knowledge of FLUBV-derived CD8+ T cell epitopes at both cellular and molecular levels, in comparison with FLUAV. Collectively, this highlights the limited data available on FLUBV, despite its significant role in human influenza infections.

analysis.summary_en: This review addresses human seasonal influenza B virus (FLUBV) with a focus on CD8+ T cell responses to conserved epitopes, contrasting with influenza A virus (FLUAV). It highlights that current vaccines, which induce humoral responses against rapidly mutating surface glycoproteins, require annual updates, whereas CD8+ T cells target more conserved epitopes, offering potential for broader protection. The review synthesizes existing knowledge on FLUBV-derived CD8+ T cell epitopes at cellular and molecular levels, explicitly comparing FLUBV to FLUAV. It concludes that CD8+ T cell responses to FLUBV are understudied, with limited data available despite FLUBV's significant role in human influenza infections. Vaccines typically induce humoral-mediated protection against rapidly mutating surface glycoproteins, necessitating that they be updated and administered each year. In contrast, CD8+ T cells, which can control and clear viral infections, can recognise more conserved viral epitopes. Therefore, there is considerable interest in understanding CD8+ T cell responses to influenza virus for the development of future vaccines and therapeutics. Although Alphainfluenzavirus influenzae (FLUAV) and Betainfluenzavirus influenzae (FLUBV) co-circulate in humans and both contribute to seasonal epidemics, there is limited data regarding CD8+ T cell responses to FLUBV. This knowledge gap spans both immunological and molecular insights. In the present review, we summarise the current knowledge of FLUBV-derived CD8+ T cell epitopes at both cellular and molecular levels, in comparison with FLUAV. Collectively, this highlights the limited data available on FLUBV, despite its significant role in human influenza infections.

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述检查了人类 季节性流感 B 病毒 (FLUBV),重点是 CD8+ T 细胞对保守表位的反应,与甲型流感病毒 (FLUAV) 进行对比,并解决了这些反应如何为未来的 疫苗 和治疗提供信息的核心问题。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述综合了细胞和分子水平上 FLUBV 衍生的 CD8+ T 细胞表位的最新知识,明确比较了 FLUBV 与 FLUAV,并强调了有关 FLUBV 的可用数据有限,尽管它在人类流感感染中发挥着作用。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述得出的结论是,CD8+ T 细胞比体液反应识别更保守的病毒表位,从而提供了更广泛保护的潜力,但指出与 FLUAV 相比,FLUBV 特异性 CD8+ T 细胞表位数据仍然稀疏。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述指出了关于 FLUBV 衍生的 CD8+ T 细胞表位的重大知识差距,涵盖免疫学和分子见解,并强调在这方面缺乏 FLUBV 和 FLUAV 之间的比较数据。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述优先研究表征 FLUBV 衍生的 CD8+ T 细胞表位及其 HLA I 类分子的呈递,旨在指导 疫苗 和利用保守 T 细胞反应的疗法的开发。

title: Development of a multi-species luciferase-based double-antigen ELISA for the detection of antibodies against influenza A virus H5 clade 2.3.4.4b
abstract: The highly pathogenic avian influenza viruses of subtype H5N1 represent a major threat to animal and public health. The current panzootic with H5 clade 2.3.4.4b has caused numerous, widespread outbreaks in various domestic and wild avian species with high mortalities, massive losses, and a high frequency of spillover events to unexpected novel mammalian hosts, such as dairy cows. The global H5N1 situation raises serious concerns about zoonotic risks due to effective mammal-to-mammal transmission. Therefore, it is critical to increase surveillance intensity of a broadened species range, particularly at the human-animal interface. For this purpose, reliable and cost-effective serological tools that are easy to perform and suitable for high-throughput screening are critically needed. The newly developed double-antigen enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay format employing a luminescence-based detection technology has demonstrated compliance with such prerequisites. The assay allowed sensitive and specific detection of antibodies directed against H5 hemagglutinin of clade 2.3.4.4b in a wide range of birds and mammals, including humans. Furthermore, it allowed differentiating H5 anti-head-specific from cross-reacting anti-stalk antibodies, which represents a valuable feature with regard to the monitoring of future vaccination programs with H5-specific vaccines. Thus, the assay is a significant contribution to existing serological diagnostic tests for a clade-optimized and species-independent detection of influenza A virus antibodies. IMPORTANCE: The ongoing highly pathogenic avian influenza virus H5N1 panzootic has caused numerous outbreaks in domestic and wild animals, with frequent spillover events to unexpected host species, which underscores the importance of intensified surveillance. However, sensitive and specific multi-species serological assays represent a major gap. elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该测定可以为在人-动物界面上开发更有效的 监测 策略提供信息。它还可以通过区分抗头抗体和抗茎抗体来支持使用 H5 特异性 疫苗 监控未来的 疫苗接种 程序。

title: Seasonal influenza vaccine effectiveness in Thailand, 2022–2025: a multi-season test-negative design study
abstract: Abstract Background Seasonal influenza vaccination is a key public health strategy for reducing influenza-related morbidity and mortality. In Thailand, influenza vaccine effectiveness (VE) is routinely evaluated using surveillance data; however, VE may vary by season, virus subtype, and population subgroup. Continuous monitoring is essential to inform vaccination policy and program performance. Methods We conducted a retrospective observational study using a test-negative design to estimate influenza VE in Thailand from 2022 to 2025. Data were obtained from sentinel surveillance across nine hospitals in four regions, including Bangkok. Patients presenting with influenza-like illness (ILI) or severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) who were tested for influenza by RT-PCR were included. Cases were influenza-positive patients, and controls were influenza-negative patients. Vaccination status was based on self-report and verified through medical records or registry data, with vaccination defined as receipt of influenza vaccine at least 14 days prior to symptom onset. VE was estimated using mixed-effects logistic regression adjusted for age group, sex, comorbidity, obesity, patient severity, epidemiologic week, and influenza season, with hospital included as a random effect. Results A total of 26,623 participants were included, comprising 4,395 influenza-positive cases and 22,228 controls. Overall VE against laboratory-confirmed influenza was 46% (95% confidence interval [CI]: 37–54). VE was relatively consistent across seasons (42% to 52%). By subtype, VE was highest against influenza B (64%; 95% CI: 49–74), followed by A(H3N2) (46%; 95% CI: 34–56) and A(H1N1) (35%; 95% CI: 15–51). Subgroup analyses showed higher VE among adults aged 18–64 years (57%; 95% CI: 44–67) and lower, non-significant VE among young children and older adults. VE was higher among outpatients than among severe cases. Conclusions Seasonal influenza vaccination provided moderate protection against laboratory-confirmed influenza in Thailand, with consistent effectiveness across multiple seasons. These findings support continued influenza vaccination programs and highlight the importance of ongoing VE monitoring to inform public health policy and improve vaccination strategies, particularly among high-risk populations.

title: Emergence of an antigenically drifted and reassorted influenza B virus at the end of the 2024–25 influenza season
abstract: ABSTRACT Influenza B virus (IBV) is a significant contributor to annual and severe cases of influenza, particularly in the young and elderly. Late in the 2024–25 Northern Hemisphere influenza season, a surge of IBV cases was identified in the Johns Hopkins Hospital Systems. The IBV responsible for the surge, C.3.1/re, was a clade C.3 virus that had reassorted with clade C.5.1 viruses and acquired the D197N mutation in hemagglutinin, restoring a putative N-linked glycan predicted to mask a key neutralizing antibody epitope. The C.3.1/re viruses preferentially infected children but showed no significant change in disease severity. C.3.1/re viruses were poorly neutralized by pre- and post-influenza vaccination serum in a human cohort. The removal of the glycan at residue 197 restored neutralizing antibody recognition. analysis.research_question_and_background: Influenza B virus (IBV) contributes substantially to annual influenza burden, particularly in children and the elderly, yet its antigenic and genetic evolution challenges vaccine strain selection and effectiveness. The study addresses a knowledge gap regarding the emergence of antigenically drifted and reassorted IBV variants late in the 2024–25 season and their implications for vaccine mismatch.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study investigated a surge of IBV cases in the Johns Hopkins Hospital Systems late in the 2024–25 Northern Hemisphere influenza season. It characterized the antigenically drifted and reassorted IBV C.3.1/re genotype and assessed its antigenic properties using human serum cohorts and phylogenetic analysis.
analysis.methods: Phylogenetic analysis was performed to trace the emergence and reassortment events of C.3.1/re viruses. Neutralizing antibody responses were measured in human cohorts using pre- and post-vaccination serum against C.3.1/re viruses. The role of hemagglutinin glycosylation at residue 197 was evaluated by removing the glycan and testing neutralization.
analysis.main_results: The C.3.1/re viruses preferentially infected children and showed no significant change in disease severity compared to other IBV infections. C.3.1/re viruses were poorly neutralized by pre- and post-influenza vaccination serum in a human cohort. Removal of the glycan at residue 197 restored neutralizing antibody recognition.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The emergence of C.3.1/re IBV with the D197N mutation and reassortment events indicates a period of significant antigenic and genetic expansion in IBV. The study demonstrates that 197 glycosylation critically drives antigenic drift in C.3.1/re, highlighting a mechanism for vaccine mismatch.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings caution that the 2025–26 and 2026 Southern Hemisphere vaccine strains are antigenically mismatched with circulating C.3.1/re IBV, and the 2026–27 Northern Hemisphere vaccine strain may also fail to recognize key epitopes due to loss of the 197 glycan.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a single hospital system and a human cohort, which may restrict generalizability. The evidence strength is moderate due to the absence of broader population-level data and the reliance on in vitro neutralization assays rather than clinical vaccine effectiveness data.

analysis.summary_en: This study describes the emergence of an antigenically drifted and reassorted influenza B virus (IBV) genotype, C.3.1/re, late in the 2024–25 Northern Hemisphere influenza season, identified in the Johns Hopkins Hospital Systems. The C.3.1/re viruses preferentially infected children and exhibited poor neutralization by pre- and post-vaccination human serum, indicating antigenic mismatch with vaccine strains. Phylogenetic analysis revealed multiple reassortment events between C.3 and C.5 clades and independent acquisitions of the D197N mutation, which restores a glycan masking a key neutralizing epitope. Removal of the glycan at residue 197 restored antibody recognition, demonstrating its critical role in antigenic drift. The 2025–26 and 2026 Southern Hemisphere vaccine strains are antigenically mismatched with C.3.1/re, and the 2026–27 Northern Hemisphere vaccine strain may also fail due to loss of the 197 glycan. These findings underscore the need for enhanced surveillance and adaptive vaccine strain selection to address the expanding antigenic diversity of IBV.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: B 型流感病毒 (IBV) 极大地增加了每年的流感负担,特别是在儿童和老年人中,但其抗原性和遗传性 进化 对 疫苗 毒株的选择和有效性提出了挑战。该研究解决了关于 2024-25 赛季末出现的抗原漂移和重配 IBV 变异及其对 疫苗 错配的影响的知识差距。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究调查了 2024-25 年北半球流感季节末约翰·霍普金斯医院系统中 IBV 病例激增的情况。它表征了抗原漂移和重配的 IBV C.3.1/re 基因型,并使用人血清 队列研究 和系统发育分析评估其抗原特性。
elements_zh.methods: 进行系统发育分析以追踪 C.3.1/re 病毒的出现和重配事件。使用针对 C.3.1/re 病毒的 队列研究 前后血清测量人 队列研究 的中和抗体反应。通过去除聚糖并测试中和来评估残基 197 处血凝素糖基化的作用。
elements_zh.main_results: C.3.1/re 病毒优先感染儿童,与其他 IBV 感染相比,疾病严重程度没有显着变化。在人 队列研究 中,流感前和流感后 疫苗接种 血清对 C.3.1/re 病毒的中和效果很差。去除残基 197 处的聚糖恢复了中和抗体识别。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: C.3.1/re IBV 与 D197N 突变 和重配事件的出现表明 IBV 存在一段显着的抗原和遗传扩张时期。该研究表明,197 糖基化在 C.3.1/re 中关键驱动 抗原漂移,突出了 疫苗 错配的机制。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果警告说,2025-26 和 2026 南半球 疫苗 菌株与循环的 C.3.1/re IBV 在抗原上不匹配,而 2026-27 北半球 疫苗 菌株也可能由于 197 聚糖的丢失而无法识别关键表位。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于单个医院系统和人类 队列研究,这可能会限制普遍性。由于缺乏更广泛的人群水平数据以及依赖体外中和测定而不是临床 疫苗 有效性数据,证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: C.3.1/re IBV 与 D197N 突变 和重配事件的出现表明 IBV 存在一段显着的抗原和遗传扩张时期。该研究表明,197 糖基化在 C.3.1/re 中关键驱动 抗原漂移,突出了 疫苗 错配的机制。

title: Pre-existing and breadth of immunity to seasonal influenza viruses among community-dwelling older adults in Thailand
abstract: Older adults are at high risk for influenza-associated morbidity and mortality. Monitoring influenza immunity in this population is crucial for disease prevention and control. However, data on immunity to seasonal influenza viruses among elderly populations remain limited. This study aimed to characterize the quantity, functional quality, and breadth of antibody responses to circulating influenza viruses among community-dwelling elderly in Thailand. A total of 442 plasma samples from elderly individuals aged ≥ 60 years residing in high-density urban communities in central Thailand, collected during 2022–2023, were analyzed. Antibody responses to four representative circulating A/H1N1, A/H3N2, and type B (Victoria and Yamagata lineages) influenza viruses were assessed using hemagglutination inhibition (HAI) and microneutralization (MNT) assays. In accordance with World Health Organization guidance on influenza vaccination, seroprotection is defined as HAI titers equal to or exceeding 40. Most elderly individuals exhibited pre-existing antibodies to all circulating influenza viruses. HAI titers and seroprotection rates were higher against influenza B viruses than influenza A viruses, with the weakest responses observed against A/H3N2. In contrast, neutralizing (NT) antibodies were universally detectable, with NT titers consistently exceeding HAI titers across all strains. Despite exhibiting the highest HAI titers against B/Victoria lineage, this virus showed the highest HAI to MNT ratio, indicating reduced functional antibody quality. Older age (≥ 65 years) and female were associated with higher HAI titers against influenza A viruses; however, these factors did not consistently translate into increased NT activity. Only 15.6% of the older adults exhibited broad antibodies against all four circulating strains, indicating limited cross-strain breadth. The elderly population exhibits pre-existing immunity to seasonal influenza A and B viruses; however, these observational serological findings are heterogeneous, strongly strain-specific, and limited in breadth, with notable gaps against A/H3N2. Functional immunity assessed by MNT may differ from estimates based on HAI, underscoring that incorporating assessment of antibody functional quality could provide complementary information for influenza surveillance. The data provide a comprehensive serosurveillance and support the use of enhanced vaccination strategies to mitigate influenza-associated risk in ageing populations.

title_zh: 泰国社区居住的老年人对 季节性流感 病毒的预先存在的免疫力和广泛性
source_body_en: Older adults are at high risk for influenza-associated morbidity and mortality. Monitoring influenza immunity in this population is crucial for disease prevention and control. However, data on immunity to seasonal influenza viruses among elderly populations remain limited. This study aimed to characterize the quantity, functional quality, and breadth of antibody responses to circulating influenza viruses among community-dwelling elderly in Thailand. A total of 442 plasma samples from elderly individuals aged ≥ 60 years residing in high-density urban communities in central Thailand, collected during 2022–2023, were analyzed. Antibody responses to four representative circulating A/H1N1, A/H3N2, and type B (Victoria and Yamagata lineages) influenza viruses were assessed using hemagglutination inhibition (HAI) and microneutralization (MNT) assays. In accordance with World Health Organization guidance on influenza vaccination, seroprotection is defined as HAI titers equal to or exceeding 40. Most elderly individuals exhibited pre-existing antibodies to all circulating influenza viruses. HAI titers and seroprotection rates were higher against influenza B viruses than influenza A viruses, with the weakest responses observed against A/H3N2. In contrast, neutralizing (NT) antibodies were universally detectable, with NT titers consistently exceeding HAI titers across all strains. Despite exhibiting the highest HAI titers against B/Victoria lineage, this virus showed the highest HAI to MNT ratio, indicating reduced functional antibody quality. Older age (≥ 65 years) and female were associated with higher HAI titers against influenza A viruses; however, these factors did not consistently translate into increased NT activity. Only 15.6% of the older adults exhibited broad antibodies against all four circulating strains, indicating limited cross-strain breadth. The elderly population exhibits pre-existing immunity to seasonal influenza A and B viruses; however, these observational serological findings are heterogeneous, strongly strain-specific, and limited in breadth, with notable gaps against A/H3N2. Functional immunity assessed by MNT may differ from estimates based on HAI, underscoring that incorporating assessment of antibody functional quality could provide complementary information for influenza surveillance. The data provide a comprehensive serosurveillance and support the use of enhanced vaccination strategies to mitigate influenza-associated risk in ageing populations.
abstract_zh: 老年人患流感相关发病和 死亡率 的风险很高。监测该人群的流感免疫力对于疾病预防和控制至关重要。然而,老年人群对 季节性流感 病毒免疫力的数据仍然有限。本研究旨在表征泰国社区老年人对流行流感病毒的抗体反应的数量、功能质量和广度。对 2022 年至 2023 年间居住在泰国中部高密度城市社区的 60 岁以上老年人的总共 442 份血浆样本进行了分析。使用血凝抑制 (HAI) 和微量中和 (MNT) 测定评估对四种代表性循环 A/H1N1、A/H3N2 和 B 型(维多利亚和山形谱系)流感病毒的抗体反应。根据世界卫生组织关于流感的指南 疫苗接种,血清保护被定义为 HAI 滴度等于或超过 40。大多数老年人表现出针对所有流行流感病毒的预先存在的抗体。针对乙型流感病毒的 HAI 滴度和血清保护率高于甲型流感病毒,针对 A/H3N2 的反应最弱。相比之下,中和 (NT) 抗体普遍可检测到,所有菌株的 NT 滴度始终超过 HAI 滴度。尽管针对 B/Victoria 谱系表现出最高的 HAI 滴度,但该病毒表现出最高的 HAI 与 MNT 比率,表明功能性抗体质量降低。年龄较大(≥ 65 岁)和女性与针对甲型流感病毒的 HAI 滴度较高相关;然而,这些因素并没有始终如一地转化为 NT 活性的增加。只有 15.6% 的老年人表现出针对所有四种流行菌株的广泛抗体,表明交叉菌株广度有限。老年人群对季节性流感 A和B病毒表现出预先存在的免疫力;然而,这些观察到的血清学结果是异质的,具有很强的毒株特异性,并且广度有限,与 A/H3N2 存在显着差距。MNT 评估的功能免疫可能与基于 HAI 的估计不同,这强调结合抗体功能质量评估可以为流感 监测 提供补充信息。这些数据提供了全面的血清监测,并支持使用增强的 疫苗接种 策略来减轻老龄化人群中流感相关的风险。

title: Determinants of the Seasonal Influenza Vaccination Uptake Among People Aged 50 Years or Above During and After the Pandemic: A Systematic Review
abstract: Background/Objectives: Seasonal influenza vaccination (SIV) coverage remains suboptimal among adults aged ≥50 years, and the COVID-19 pandemic might influence the determinants of SIV uptake. This systematic review aimed to identify determinants of SIV uptake among adults aged ≥50 years during and after the COVID-19 pandemic. Methods: We searched PubMed, MEDLINE, Embase, Web of Science, Global Health, CINAHL, Cochrane Library, APA PsycINFO, and APA PsycArticles for studies published between 1 December 2019 and 1 January 2026. The pooled prevalence of SIV uptake was synthesized using random-effects models in meta-analysis. Results: A total of 50 studies were included in the systematic review. COVID-19-related factors, such as perceived risk of co-infection with SARS-CoV-2 and seasonal influenza and concerns about potential interactions between COVID-19 vaccines and SIV, were determinants of SIV uptake. Other modifiable determinants included those that existed before the pandemic (e.g., knowledge and perceptions of seasonal influenza and SIV). Subgroup analysis showed that cost and inaccessibility were barriers to receiving SIV in places without a fully subsidized SIV, and perceived susceptibility and vaccine safety concerns were commonly identified as facilitators and barriers in studies with data collected after the pandemic. The pooled prevalence of SIV uptake among adults aged 50 years or above was 53% (95% confidence interval: 44–62%). Such uptake appeared lower among adults aged 50–64 years, in regions without a fully subsidized SIV, and after the COVID-19 pandemic. Conclusions: These findings could inform service planning and interventions promoting SIV uptake among adults aged ≥50 years in the post-pandemic era. More studies are needed to explore determinants specific to people aged 50–64 years to inform health promotion tailored to their needs.

The review included 50 studies and found that the pooled prevalence of SIV uptake was 53% (95% confidence interval: 44–62%). elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 我们检索了 PubMed、MEDLINE、Embase、Web of Science、Global Health、CINAHL、Cochrane Library、APA PsycINFO 和 APA PsycArticles 2019 年 12 月 1 日至 2026 年 1 月 1 日期间发表的研究。SIV 摄取的汇总 患病率 是使用荟萃分析中的随机效应模型合成的。

source_body_en: Background/Objectives: Seasonal influenza vaccination (SIV) coverage remains suboptimal among adults aged ≥50 years, and the COVID-19 pandemic might influence the determinants of SIV uptake. This systematic review aimed to identify determinants of SIV uptake among adults aged ≥50 years during and after the COVID-19 pandemic. Methods: We searched PubMed, MEDLINE, Embase, Web of Science, Global Health, CINAHL, Cochrane Library, APA PsycINFO, and APA PsycArticles for studies published between 1 December 2019 and 1 January 2026. The pooled prevalence of SIV uptake was synthesized using random-effects models in meta-analysis. Results: A total of 50 studies were included in the systematic review. COVID-19-related factors, such as perceived risk of co-infection with SARS-CoV-2 and seasonal influenza and concerns about potential interactions between COVID-19 vaccines and SIV, were determinants of SIV uptake. Other modifiable determinants included those that existed before the pandemic (e.g., knowledge and perceptions of seasonal influenza and SIV). Subgroup analysis showed that cost and inaccessibility were barriers to receiving SIV in places without a fully subsidized SIV, and perceived susceptibility and vaccine safety concerns were commonly identified as facilitators and barriers in studies with data collected after the pandemic. The pooled prevalence of SIV uptake among adults aged 50 years or above was 53% (95% confidence interval: 44–62%). Such uptake appeared lower among adults aged 50–64 years, in regions without a fully subsidized SIV, and after the COVID-19 pandemic. Conclusions: These findings could inform service planning and interventions promoting SIV uptake among adults aged ≥50 years in the post-pandemic era. More studies are needed to explore determinants specific to people aged 50–64 years to inform health promotion tailored to their needs.
abstract_zh: 背景/目标:季节性流感 疫苗接种 (SIV) 覆盖率在 50 岁以上的成年人中仍然不理想,并且 COVID-19 大流行可能会影响 SIV 吸收的决定因素。本系统综述旨在确定 COVID-19 大流行期间和之后 50 岁以上成年人吸收 SIV 的决定因素。方法:我们检索了 PubMed、MEDLINE、Embase、Web of Science、Global Health、CINAHL、Cochrane Library、APA PsycINFO 和 APA PsycArticles 2019 年 12 月 1 日至 2026 年 1 月 1 日期间发表的研究。SIV 摄取的汇总 患病率 是使用荟萃分析中的随机效应模型合成的。结果:系统评价共纳入 50 项研究。COVID-19 相关因素,例如感知 SARS-CoV-2 和 季节性流感 共同感染的风险,以及对 COVID-19 疫苗 和 SIV 之间潜在相互作用的担忧,是 SIV 摄取的决定因素。其他可修改的决定因素包括大流行之前存在的决定因素(例如,对 季节性流感 和 SIV 的知识和看法)。亚组分析表明,在没有充分补贴的 SIV 的地方,成本和交通不便是接受 SIV 的障碍,而在大流行后收集的数据研究中,感知的易感性和 疫苗 安全问题通常被认为是促进因素和障碍。50 岁或以上成年人中 SIV 吸收的汇总 患病率 为 53%(95% 置信区间:44-62%)。在 50-64 岁的成年人中、在没有全额补贴 SIV 的地区以及在 COVID-19 大流行之后,这种吸收率似乎较低。结论:这些发现可以为大流行后时代促进 50 岁以上成年人吸收 SIV 的服务规划和干预措施提供信息。需要更多的研究来探索 50-64 岁人群特有的决定因素,以便为适合他们需求的健康促进提供信息。

title: Kiến thức, thực hành về tiêm vắc xin phòng bệnh cúm mùa và một số yếu tố liên quan của khách hàng đến Phòng tiêm chủng Trường Đại học Y Hà Nội năm 2025 Knowledge and practices regarding seasonal influenza vaccination and some related factors of clients to the vaccination center of Hanoi Medical University in 2025
abstract: Nghiên cứu cắt ngang được thực hiện năm 2025 bằng phương pháp chọn mẫu thuận tiện trên 280 kháchhàng đến Phòng Tiêm chủng Trường Đại học Y Hà Nội nhằm mô tả kiến thức, thực hành về tiêm vắc xinphòng bệnh cúm mùa và phân tích một số yếu tố liên quan. Kết quả cho thấy 44,3% đối tượng có kiến thứctốt và 40,4% đã tiêm vắc xin cúm mùa trong vòng 12 tháng qua. Phân tích hồi quy logistic đơn biến ghinhận kiến thức có liên quan với tuổi >30 (OR = 1,84; KTC95%: 1,11–3,05), trình độ học vấn (sơ cấp/ trungcấp/ cao đẳng: OR = 3,07; KTC95%: 1,14–8,62; đại học/sau đại học: OR = 2,28; KTC95%: 1,07–8,60), đãkết hôn (OR = 1,68; KTC95%: 1,01–2,85) và thu nhập 15–20 triệu đồng/ tháng (OR = 2,72; KTC95%: 1,21–6,34). Thực hành tiêm vắc xin cúm mùa có liên quan với nơi cư trú (ngoại thành: OR = 0,23; KTC95%:0,07–0,67; ngoài tỉnh: OR = 0,53; KTC95%: 0,30–0,93), nghề nghiệp (hành chính/văn phòng: OR = 2,19;KTC95%: 1,12–4,40; hưu trí/nội trợ: OR = 4,15; KTC95%: 1,56–11,53) và đã kết hôn (OR = 2,10; KTC95%:1,20–3,57). Tỷ lệ kiến thức tốt và thực hành tiêm vắc xin cúm mùa còn chưa cao. Cần tăng cường truyềnthông, tư vấn nhằm nâng cao nhận thức và thúc đẩy thực hành tiêm chủng tại cơ sở.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed low uptake and knowledge gaps regarding seasonal influenza vaccination among clients attending a university vaccination center in Hanoi in 2025, aiming to describe knowledge and practices and identify associated factors.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study was conducted in 2025 using convenience sampling of 280 clients attending the vaccination center of Hanoi Medical University to assess knowledge and practices about seasonal influenza vaccination.
analysis.methods: The study used convenience sampling and descriptive analysis to evaluate knowledge and vaccination practices, with logistic regression to identify factors associated with knowledge and practice outcomes.
analysis.main_results: Good knowledge was reported by 44.3% of participants, and 40.4% had received seasonal influenza vaccine within the past 12 months. Knowledge was associated with age over 30 years, lower education levels, being married, and monthly income of 15–20 million Vietnamese dong.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that knowledge and vaccination practices remain suboptimal and identified demographic and socioeconomic factors influencing both knowledge and vaccination behavior.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest targeted communication and counseling are needed to improve seasonal influenza vaccination uptake and knowledge among specific demographic groups in Hanoi.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The cross-sectional design and convenience sampling limit causal inference and generalizability; evidence strength is assessed as moderate due to potential selection bias and unmeasured confounders.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study conducted in 2025 at Hanoi Medical University assessed knowledge and practices regarding seasonal influenza vaccination among 280 clients using convenience sampling. It found that 44.3% had good knowledge and 40.4% had received the vaccine in the past year. Knowledge was associated with age over 30 years, lower education levels, being married, and higher income, while vaccination practice was linked to residence, occupation, and marital status. The authors concluded that knowledge and vaccination rates remain insufficient and recommended targeted communication to improve uptake. The study’s moderate evidence strength reflects its cross-sectional design and convenience sampling, which limit causal inference and generalizability.

analysis_en.main_results: Good knowledge was reported by 44.3% of participants, and 40.4% had received seasonal influenza vaccine within the past 12 months. Knowledge was associated with age over 30 years, lower education levels, being married, and monthly income of 15–20 million Vietnamese dong.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that knowledge and vaccination practices remain suboptimal and identified demographic and socioeconomic factors influencing both knowledge and vaccination behavior.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest targeted communication and counseling are needed to improve seasonal influenza vaccination uptake and knowledge among specific demographic groups in Hanoi.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The cross-sectional design and convenience sampling limit causal inference and generalizability; evidence strength is assessed as moderate due to potential selection bias and unmeasured confounders.

title_zh: Kiến thức、thực hành về tiêm vắc xin phòng bệnh cúm mua và một số yếu tố liên quan của khách hàng đến Phòng tiêm chủng Trường Đại học Y Hà Nội năm 2025 2025年河内医科大学疫苗接种中心客户关于季节性流感 疫苗接种的知识和实践以及一些相关因素
source_body_en: Nghiên cứu cắt ngang được thực hiện năm 2025 bằng phương pháp chọn mẫu thuận tiện trên 280 kháchhàng đến Phòng Tiêm chủng Trường Đại học Y Hà Nội nhằm mô tả kiến thức, thực hành về tiêm vắc xinphòng bệnh cúm mùa và phân tích một số yếu tố liên quan. Kết quả cho thấy 44,3% đối tượng có kiến thứctốt và 40,4% đã tiêm vắc xin cúm mùa trong vòng 12 tháng qua. Phân tích hồi quy logistic đơn biến ghinhận kiến thức có liên quan với tuổi >30 (OR = 1,84; KTC95%: 1,11–3,05), trình độ học vấn (sơ cấp/ trungcấp/ cao đẳng: OR = 3,07; KTC95%: 1,14–8,62; đại học/sau đại học: OR = 2,28; KTC95%: 1,07–8,60), đãkết hôn (OR = 1,68; KTC95%: 1,01–2,85) và thu nhập 15–20 triệu đồng/ tháng (OR = 2,72; KTC95%: 1,21–6,34). Thực hành tiêm vắc xin cúm mùa có liên quan với nơi cư trú (ngoại thành: OR = 0,23; KTC95%:0,07–0,67; ngoài tỉnh: OR = 0,53; KTC95%: 0,30–0,93), nghề nghiệp (hành chính/văn phòng: OR = 2,19;KTC95%: 1,12–4,40; hưu trí/nội trợ: OR = 4,15; KTC95%: 1,56–11,53) và đã kết hôn (OR = 2,10; KTC95%:1,20–3,57). Tỷ lệ kiến thức tốt và thực hành tiêm vắc xin cúm mùa còn chưa cao. Cần tăng cường truyềnthông, tư vấn nhằm nâng cao nhận thức và thúc đẩy thực hành tiêm chủng tại cơ sở.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study was needed to assess the current knowledge and vaccination practices regarding seasonal influenza vaccine among adults aged 50 years and older in Binh Giang Commune, responding to the recognized importance of influenza vaccination as the most effective means to prevent seasonal flu.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross‐sectional convenience sample of 205 adults aged 50 years and older was implemented in Binh Giang Commune, Ninh Binh Province, Vietnam, to describe their knowledge and vaccination practices.
analysis.methods: Data were collected through a convenience sampling cross‐sectional survey measuring knowledge and vaccination status via self‐report.
analysis.main_results: The survey found that 62.9% of participants had adequate knowledge of seasonal influenza and its vaccine, while only 20.9% reported receiving the seasonal influenza vaccine in 2025.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: These results reveal a substantial knowledge–action gap, indicating that despite high knowledge, vaccination uptake remains low among older adults in this setting.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The main barriers—lack of awareness, limited access to vaccination sites, and high cost—highlight the need for intensified communication, improved vaccine accessibility, and supportive vaccination programs to boost seasonal influenza vaccination in this community.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The convenience sampling and single‐site design limit generalisability, and the absence of a comparison group reduces the evidence strength to moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This cross‐sectional study surveyed 205 adults aged 50 years and older in Binh Giang Commune, Ninh Binh Province, Vietnam, in 2025 to evaluate knowledge and vaccination practices against seasonal influenza. Results showed that 62.9% of participants possessed adequate knowledge of seasonal flu and its vaccine, yet only 20.9% had received the seasonal influenza vaccine during the year. The principal barriers to vaccination were lack of awareness (28.2%), limited access to vaccination sites (24.5%), and high cost (16.0%). These findings indicate a substantial knowledge‐action gap that underscores the need for targeted public‐health communication, improved vaccine accessibility, and supportive vaccination programs to increase uptake among older adults. The convenience sampling design and single‐site approach limit the generalisability of the results, but the data provide moderate‐quality evidence on current vaccination behavior and barriers in this community.

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些结果揭示了巨大的知识与行动差距,表明尽管知识水平很高,但在这种情况下,老年人对 疫苗接种 的吸收率仍然很低。

title: Investigating host intracellular proteins with antiviral activity against influenza and herpesviruses
abstract: Human pathogenic viruses present an ongoing global public health problem, as reflected by continuing endemic infections, seasonal epidemics, and pandemics caused by newly emerging viruses. While many intracellular host proteins fulfil defined roles in normal cellular physiology and function, a subset exert intrinsic antiviral activity and are termed host restriction factors. Host restriction factors represent an important component of innate antiviral immunity and can inhibit infection and/or replication of different DNA and/or RNA viruses at distinct stages in their viral replication cycle. This thesis has focussed on studying how two host restriction factors, namely SAM domain and HD domain-containing protein 1 (SAMHD1) and Membrane-associated RING-CH-Type Finger 8 protein (MARCHF8), restrict different RNA and DNA viruses. Studies described in Chapter 3 investigated the antiviral activity of SAMHD1 against respiratory RNA viruses in human macrophage-like and epithelial cells. Using human herpes simplex type 1 virus (HSV-1) as a control to validate the functionality of our approaches, we demonstrated that neither endogenous nor overexpressed SAMHD restricted seasonal influenza A virus (IAV), human metapneumovirus (HMPV) and human parainfluenza virus type 3 (hPIV3) replication in either cell type. However, overexpression of SAMHD1 inhibited highly pathogenic avian influenza virus (HPAI) A(H5N1) in human macrophage-like cells. HSV-1 infects a wide range of cell types, including epithelial cells, keratinocytes, astrocytes, neurons and immune cells, yet most studies published to date have investigated the role of SAMHD1 in restricting HSV-1 replication in monocytes and macrophages. In Chapter 4, we focussed on assessment of SAMHD1 expression and its role in restricting HSV-1 replication in different cell types relevant to HSV-1 pathogenesis, including keratinocytes, neurons and astrocytes. We report that endogenous SAMHD1 did not restrict HSV-1 replication in any of the neuron, astrocyte or keratinocyte cell models tested, whereas restriction was observed in differentiated THP-1 macrophages. In contrast, inducible overexpression of SAMHD1 in neuronal, but not in keratinocyte cell lines, resulted in HSV-1 restriction, with variable results observed following overexpression in an astrocytic cell line. We also used human small molecule neural precursor cells (smNPCs), derived from human pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) and differentiated into neurons or astrocytes, to confirm that endogenous SAMHD1 did not restrict HSV-1 replication in either cell type. Together, these results indicate that the capacity of both endogenous and overexpressed SAMHD1 to restrict HSV-1 replication is cell-type dependent. We extended our studies of human SAMHD1 and herpesviruses to investigate the ability of bovine SAMHD1 to restrict replication of human and bovine herpesviruses (Chapter 5). We used an inducible overexpression system to express bovine SAMHD1 and, for comparison, human SAMHD1 in bovine epithelial- and macrophage-like cells, enabling assessment of their ability to restrict bovine herpesvirus type 1 (BHV-1) replication. We demonstrate that inducible expression of either bovine or human SAMHD1 restricted the replication of BHV-1, as well as HSV-1. Restriction of BHV-1 by bovine SAMHD1 correlated with the inhibition of viral genomic replication and late viral gene expression. Furthermore, by introducing mutations known to impact the nuclear localisation, dNTPase activity or antiviral activity against lentiviruses, we show that only dNTPase activity was required for restriction of BHV-1 by bovine SAMHD1. In Chapter 6, we report the ability of MARCHF8 to restrict HSV-1 replication in macrophage- or epithelial-like cells. While it is widely established that MARCHF8 can restrict replication of several RNA viruses, this represents the first report of its ability to act against a DNA virus. For many RNA viruses, MARCHF8-mediated restriction has been associated with downregulation of viral envelope glycoproteins from the cell surface, thereby limiting their subsequent incorporation into nascent virions. However, while MARCHF8 expression did not affect virus entry, translocation of viral genome to the nucleus and immediate early (IE) gene expression, it did inhibit HSV-1 genomic replication, and therefore subsequent late viral gene expression and release of infectious virions. MARCHF8-mediated restriction of HSV-1 occurred independent of other cellular factors known to impact genomic replication of HSV-1, namely SAMHD1 and CD81, and could also proceed efficiently in cells expressing a functional cGAS-STING pathway. To our knowledge, these studies are the first to demonstrate MARCHF8-mediated restriction of a human DNA virus. Moreover, inhibition of HSV-1 genomic replication represents a novel mechanism of MARCHF8-mediated virus restriction that is distinct to its reported antiviral activity against RNA viruses. Overall, our studies indicate that SAMHD1 and MARCHF8 represent broad-spectrum host restriction factors with the ability to act across different classes of viruses with distinct viral genomes, likely via mechanisms distinct to those previously described. Furthermore, we demonstrate the potential of bovine SAMHD1 to restrict replication of BHV-1, a bovine herpesvirus associated with significant economic impact in the cattle industry. Targeting host restriction factors such as SAMHD1 and MARCHF8 represents a promising approach for the development of novel host-directed antiviral therapies.

title_original: Investigating host intracellular proteins with antiviral activity against influenza and herpesviruses

analysis.research_question_and_background: Seasonal influenza viruses cause recurring epidemics and remain a global public health burden, yet the role of host restriction factors in controlling these infections is incompletely understood. This thesis aimed to investigate how host restriction factors SAMHD1 and MARCHF8 restrict influenza and herpesviruses, addressing a gap in understanding their antiviral breadth and mechanisms.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study examined the antiviral activity of SAMHD1 and MARCHF8 in human and bovine cell models, including macrophage-like, epithelial, neuronal, astrocytic, and keratinocyte cells, using inducible overexpression systems and endogenous protein assessments. The work was structured across multiple chapters, each focusing on specific virus-host interactions.
analysis.methods: Inducible overexpression systems were used to express SAMHD1 (human and bovine) and MARCHF8 in relevant cell types, enabling assessment of their ability to restrict viral replication. For SAMHD1, mutations affecting nuclear localisation, dNTPase activity, or lentiviral antiviral activity were introduced to dissect functional requirements. Viral replication was measured by assessing genomic replication, gene expression, and infectious virion release.
analysis.main_results: Neither endogenous nor overexpressed human SAMHD1 restricted seasonal influenza A virus (IAV), human metapneumovirus (HMPV), or human parainfluenza virus type 3 (hPIV3) replication in macrophage-like or epithelial cells. Overexpression of SAMHD1 inhibited highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) in human macrophage-like cells. Endogenous SAMHD1 did not restrict HSV-1 in neurons, astrocytes, or keratinocytes, though restriction was observed in differentiated THP-1 macrophages.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study demonstrates that SAMHD1 does not restrict seasonal influenza viruses but retains activity against highly pathogenic avian influenza, highlighting virus-specific differences in restriction factor efficacy. The finding that MARCHF8 restricts HSV-1 via inhibition of genomic replication represents a novel mechanism distinct from its known activity against RNA viruses.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest that host restriction factors may have limited direct impact on seasonal influenza control in common human cell types, while informing potential strategies to target highly pathogenic avian influenza. The discovery of MARCHF8’s antiviral activity against a DNA virus expands its known spectrum and may guide future antiviral research.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its focus on in vitro cell models and does not address host restriction factor activity in natural human infections or animal models. The evidence is moderate, as the absence of restriction against seasonal influenza is based on negative results in specific cell types, and broader generalisability remains uncertain.

analysis.summary_en: This thesis investigated the antiviral activity of host restriction factors SAMHD1 and MARCHF8 against influenza and herpesviruses. Using inducible overexpression and endogenous protein assessments in human and bovine cell models, the study found that neither endogenous nor overexpressed human SAMHD1 restricted seasonal influenza A virus (IAV), human metapneumovirus (HMPV), or human parainfluenza virus type 3 (hPIV3) in macrophage-like or epithelial cells. However, SAMHD1 overexpression inhibited highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) in human macrophage-like cells, indicating virus-specific differences in restriction factor efficacy. Endogenous SAMHD1 did not restrict herpes simplex virus type 1 (HSV-1) in neurons, astrocytes, or keratinocytes, though restriction was observed in differentiated THP-1 macrophages. The study also demonstrated that MARCHF8 restricts HSV-1 by inhibiting genomic replication, a novel mechanism distinct from its known activity against RNA viruses. These findings suggest limited direct impact of SAMHD1 on seasonal influenza in common human cell types, while highlighting potential for targeting highly pathogenic avian influenza and expanding the antiviral spectrum of MARCHF8.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 季节性流感 病毒引起反复流行,并仍然是全球公共卫生负担,但 宿主 限制因素在控制这些感染中的作用尚不完全清楚。本论文旨在研究 宿主 限制因子 SAMHD1 和 MARCHF8 如何限制流感和疱疹病毒,弥补对其 抗病毒药物 广度和机制的理解空白。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用诱导型过表达系统和内源性蛋白质评估,检测了 SAMHD1 和 MARCHF8 在人和牛细胞模型中的 抗病毒药物 活性,包括巨噬细胞样细胞、上皮细胞、神经元细胞、星形细胞和角质形成细胞。这项工作由多个章节组成,每个章节都侧重于特定的病毒-宿主 相互作用。
elements_zh.methods: 使用诱导过表达系统在相关细胞类型中表达 SAMHD1(人和牛)和 MARCHF8,从而能够评估它们限制病毒复制的能力。对于 SAMHD1,引入影响核定位的 突变、dNTPase 活性或慢病毒 抗病毒药物 活性来剖析功能要求。通过评估基因组复制、基因表达和感染性病毒粒子释放来测量病毒复制。
elements_zh.main_results: 内源性或过表达的人 SAMHD1 均不限制 季节性流感 A 病毒 (IAV)、人偏肺病毒 (HMPV) 或人副流感病毒 3 型 (hPIV3) 在巨噬细胞样细胞或上皮细胞中的复制。SAMHD1 的过度表达可抑制人巨噬细胞样细胞中的高致病性禽流感 A (H5N1)。内源性 SAMHD1 不会限制神经元、星形胶质细胞或角质形成细胞中的 HSV-1,但在分化的 THP-1 巨噬细胞中观察到限制。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究表明,SAMHD1 不会限制 季节性流感 病毒,但保留了针对高致病性禽流感的活性,突出了限制因子功效中病毒特异性的差异。MARCHF8 通过抑制基因组复制来限制 HSV-1 的发现代表了一种不同于其已知的抗 RNA 病毒活性的新机制。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,宿主 限制因子可能对常见人类细胞类型中的 季节性流感 控制产生有限的直接影响,同时为针对高致病性禽流感的潜在策略提供信息。MARCHF8 针对 DNA 病毒的 抗病毒药物 活性的发现扩大了其已知谱,并可能指导未来的 抗病毒药物 研究。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其重点关注体外细胞模型而受到限制,并未解决自然人类感染或动物模型中 宿主 限制因子的活性。证据是中等的,因为对 季节性流感 的限制是基于特定细胞类型的阴性结果,并且更广泛的普遍性仍然不确定。

In Chapter 4, we focussed on assessment of SAMHD1 expression and its role in restricting HSV-1 replication in different cell types relevant to HSV-1 pathogenesis, including keratinocytes, neurons and astrocytes. We report that endogenous SAMHD1 did not restrict HSV-1 replication in any of the neuron, astrocyte or keratinocyte cell models tested, whereas restriction was observed in differentiated THP-1 macrophages. In contrast, inducible overexpression of SAMHD1 in neuronal, but not in keratinocyte cell lines, resulted in HSV-1 restriction, with variable results observed following overexpression in an astrocytic cell line. We also used human small molecule neural precursor cells (smNPCs), derived from human pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) and differentiated into neurons or astrocytes, to confirm that endogenous SAMHD1 did not restrict HSV-1 replication in either cell type. Together, these results indicate that the capacity of both endogenous and overexpressed SAMHD1 to restrict HSV-1 replication is cell-type dependent. We extended our studies of human SAMHD1 and herpesviruses to investigate the ability of bovine SAMHD1 to restrict replication of human and bovine herpesviruses (Chapter 5). We used an inducible overexpression system to express bovine SAMHD1 and, for comparison, human SAMHD1 in bovine epithelial- and macrophage-like cells, enabling assessment of their ability to restrict bovine herpesvirus type 1 (BHV-1) replication. We demonstrate that inducible expression of either bovine or human SAMHD1 restricted the replication of BHV-1, as well as HSV-1. Restriction of BHV-1 by bovine SAMHD1 correlated with the inhibition of viral genomic replication and late viral gene expression. Furthermore, by introducing mutations known to impact the nuclear localisation, dNTPase activity or antiviral activity against lentiviruses, we show that only dNTPase activity was required for restriction of BHV-1 by bovine SAMHD1. In Chapter 6, we report the ability of MARCHF8 to restrict HSV-1 replication in macrophage- or epithelial-like cells. While it is widely established that MARCHF8 can restrict replication of several RNA viruses, this represents the first report of its ability to act against a DNA virus. For many RNA viruses, MARCHF8-mediated restriction has been associated with downregulation of viral envelope glycoproteins from the cell surface, thereby limiting their subsequent incorporation into nascent virions. However, while MARCHF8 expression did not affect virus entry, translocation of viral genome to the nucleus and immediate early (IE) gene expression, it did inhibit HSV-1 genomic replication, and therefore subsequent late viral gene expression and release of infectious virions. MARCHF8-mediated restriction of HSV-1 occurred independent of other cellular factors known to impact genomic replication of HSV-1, namely SAMHD1 and CD81, and could also proceed efficiently in cells expressing a functional cGAS-STING pathway. To our knowledge, these studies are the first to demonstrate MARCHF8-mediated restriction of a human DNA virus. Moreover, inhibition of HSV-1 genomic replication represents a novel mechanism of MARCHF8-mediated virus restriction that is distinct to its reported antiviral activity against RNA viruses. Overall, our studies indicate that SAMHD1 and MARCHF8 represent broad-spectrum host restriction factors with the ability to act across different classes of viruses with distinct viral genomes, likely via mechanisms distinct to those previously described. Furthermore, we demonstrate the potential of bovine SAMHD1 to restrict replication of BHV-1, a bovine herpesvirus associated with significant economic impact in the cattle industry. Targeting host restriction factors such as SAMHD1 and MARCHF8 represents a promising approach for the development of novel host-directed antiviral therapies.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 季节性流感 病毒引起反复流行,并仍然是全球公共卫生负担,但 宿主 限制因素在控制这些感染中的作用尚不完全清楚。本论文旨在研究 宿主 限制因子 SAMHD1 和 MARCHF8 如何限制流感和疱疹病毒,弥补对其 抗病毒药物 广度和机制的理解空白。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用诱导型过表达系统和内源性蛋白质评估,检测了 SAMHD1 和 MARCHF8 在人和牛细胞模型中的 抗病毒药物 活性,包括巨噬细胞样细胞、上皮细胞、神经元细胞、星形细胞和角质形成细胞。这项工作由多个章节组成,每个章节都侧重于特定的病毒-宿主 相互作用。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用诱导过表达系统在相关细胞类型中表达 SAMHD1(人和牛)和 MARCHF8,从而能够评估它们限制病毒复制的能力。对于 SAMHD1,引入影响核定位的 突变、dNTPase 活性或慢病毒 抗病毒药物 活性来剖析功能要求。通过评估基因组复制、基因表达和感染性病毒粒子释放来测量病毒复制。
analysis_zh.main_results: 内源性或过表达的人 SAMHD1 均不限制 季节性流感 A 病毒 (IAV)、人偏肺病毒 (HMPV) 或人副流感病毒 3 型 (hPIV3) 在巨噬细胞样细胞或上皮细胞中的复制。SAMHD1 的过度表达可抑制人巨噬细胞样细胞中的高致病性禽流感 A (H5N1)。内源性 SAMHD1 不会限制神经元、星形胶质细胞或角质形成细胞中的 HSV-1,但在分化的 THP-1 巨噬细胞中观察到限制。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究表明,SAMHD1 不会限制 季节性流感 病毒,但保留了针对高致病性禽流感的活性,突出了限制因子功效中病毒特异性的差异。MARCHF8 通过抑制基因组复制来限制 HSV-1 的发现代表了一种不同于其已知的抗 RNA 病毒活性的新机制。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,宿主 限制因子可能对常见人类细胞类型中的 季节性流感 控制产生有限的直接影响,同时为针对高致病性禽流感的潜在策略提供信息。MARCHF8 针对 DNA 病毒的 抗病毒药物 活性的发现扩大了其已知谱,并可能指导未来的 抗病毒药物 研究。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其重点关注体外细胞模型而受到限制,并未解决自然人类感染或动物模型中 宿主 限制因子的活性。证据是中等的,因为对 季节性流感 的限制是基于特定细胞类型的阴性结果,并且更广泛的普遍性仍然不确定。

title: CD73 controls neutrophil responsiveness to type I interferon impairing antibacterial responses during influenza A virus/ Streptococcus pneumoniae co-infection
abstract: Streptococcus pneumoniae (pneumococcus) are asymptomatic colonizers of the nasopharynx but can progress to pulmonary and systemic pathogens upon influenza A virus (IAV) infection. Polymorphonuclear cells (PMNs) are required to control bacterial numbers, but we previously found that IAV infection impairs their ability to kill S. Here, using a model that allows transition of pneumococci from colonizers to disease-causing pathogens upon IAV co-infection, we examined the signaling pathways impairing PMN responses. When we investigated the effect of type I interferons (IFN) produced upon IAV infection on PMN antibacterial activity, we found that PMNs treated with IFN were unable to kill S. pneumoniae ex vivo, and that in vivo blocking of IFN receptor 1 (IFNAR1) in IAV infected mice rescued PMN antibacterial function. In exploring what controls PMN responsiveness to IFN, we examined CD73, an ectonucleotidase that is known to regulate PMN function in primary pneumococcal pneumonia. To test if there is an intersection between CD73 and IFN signaling, we examined receptor levels and IFN production in wild type versus CD73KO mice and found no difference in IFNAR expression on PMNs or IFNɑ and IFNꞵ levels in the lungs and circulation. However, CD73KO PMNs expressed significantly lower levels of the interferon stimulated protein IFIT1. When we looked at ex vivo PMN responsiveness to IFNs, CD73KO PMNs were less responsive to IFN-mediated inhibition of antimicrobial activity. In exploring mechanisms, we found that CD73 expressing PMNs had elevated production of reactive oxygen species in response to IAV challenge, that paradoxically impaired their ability to kill S. Importantly, despite similar pathogen loads in the respiratory tract, co-infected CD73KO mice cleared bacteremia and survived significantly better than wild type controls. These findings suggest that CD73 impairs host defense against IAV/S. pneumoniae co-infection in part by sensitizing PMNs to type I IFN-mediated inhibition of antibacterial function.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates how influenza A virus (IAV) infection affects the ability of polymorphonuclear cells (PMNs) to combat Streptococcus pneumoniae, particularly focusing on the role of type I interferons (IFN). Using a model where pneumococci transition from colonizers to pathogens upon IAV co-infection, the researchers examined the signaling pathways that impair PMN responses. They found that PMNs treated with IFN were unable to kill S. pneumoniae ex vivo, and in vivo blocking of IFN receptor 1 (IFNAR1) in IAV-infected mice rescued PMN antibacterial function. Additionally, CD73KO PMNs expressed significantly lower levels of the interferon stimulated protein IFIT1. These findings suggest that CD73 impairs host defense against IAV/S. pneumoniae co-infection by sensitizing PMNs to type I IFN-mediated inhibition of antibacterial function. The results highlight the importance of understanding the interplay between viral and bacterial infections in the context of immune response modulation, which could inform strategies for improving treatment and prevention in co-infected patients. However, the study is limited to ex vivo and in vivo models, and the evidence is based on a single model system, which may affect generalizability.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在调查甲型流感病毒(IAV)感染如何影响多形核细胞(PMN)对抗肺炎链球菌的能力,特别关注I型干扰素(IFN)在此过程中的作用。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用了肺炎球菌在 IAV 合并感染时从定植者转变为病原体的模型,检查了在这种情况下损害 PMN 反应的信号通路。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员研究了 IAV 感染期间产生的 I 型干扰素对 PMN 抗菌活性的影响,比较野生型和 CD73KO 小鼠以评估受体水平和 IFN 产生。
elements_zh.main_results: 用 IFN 处理的 PMN 无法离体杀死肺炎链球菌,而体内阻断 IAV 感染小鼠的 IFN 受体 1 (IFNAR1) 可挽救 PMN 的抗菌功能。CD73KO PMN 的干扰素刺激蛋白 IFIT1 表达水平显着降低。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明 CD73 削弱了 宿主 对 IAV/S 的防御。通过使 PMN 对 I 型 IFN 介导的抗菌功能抑制敏感来治疗肺炎链球菌合并感染。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果提供了对 IAV 感染损害 宿主 对细菌合并感染的防御机制的见解,这可以为改善 治疗 和合并感染患者的预防策略提供参考。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于离体和体内模型,证据基于单一模型系统,这可能会影响普遍性。证据强度中等。

title: Molecular Surveillance and Nanopore Sequencing Reveal the Circulation and Genetic Diversity of Low-Pathogenic Avian Influenza A Viruses in Migratory Birds from Ukraine
abstract: Wild migratory birds are the principal natural reservoir of influenza A viruses (IAVs) and play a central role in their evolution and global dissemination. Ukraine lies along the Black Sea–Mediterranean Flyway, making surveillance of avian influenza viruses in wild birds essential within a One Health framework, although genomic data from the region remain limited. Between October 2025 and January 2026 In some places you say December 2025 and in other places you say January 2026. I do not understand the differences, 604 cloacal and oropharyngeal swabs and environmental fecal samples were collected from migratory birds and mixed-species flocks in the Tuzlivski lymany National Nature Park and surrounding areas, together with samples from nearby domestic poultry. Influenza A virus was detected by real-time RT-PCR targeting the matrix gene, followed by H5/H7 screening, Oxford Nanopore sequencing of complete hemagglutinin genes, and phylogenetic analysis. Influenza A virus RNA was identified in 30/604 samples (4.97%), whereas all samples were negative for H5 and H7 subtypes. Complete hemagglutinin sequences revealed three low-pathogenic subtypes (H1, H4, and H6) that clustered within established Eurasian lineages closely related to contemporary avian viruses circulating across Europe, Asia, and North America. No influenza A virus or Newcastle disease virus was detected in domestic poultry. These findings provide an important genomic baseline for avian influenza surveillance in Ukraine and demonstrate the value of portable nanopore sequencing and integrated One Health surveillance for monitoring viral diversity and supporting early detection of emerging influenza threats.

analysis.methods: Influenza A virus was detected using real-time RT-PCR targeting the matrix gene, followed by H5/H7 subtype screening. Positive samples underwent Oxford Nanopore sequencing of complete hemagglutinin genes and phylogenetic analysis to determine genetic lineages.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 野生候鸟是甲型流感病毒的主要自然 储存宿主,并推动其在全球传播,但来自乌克兰的 基因组监测 数据很少。该研究旨在通过表征乌克兰境内候鸟中循环的低致病性甲型禽流感病毒来解决这一差距。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究收集了 2025 年 10 月至 2026 年 1 月期间图兹利夫斯基利马尼国家自然公园及周边地区候鸟和混合物种鸡群的 604 份泄殖腔和口咽拭子以及环境粪便样本,以及附近家禽的样本。
elements_zh.methods: 使用针对基质基因的实时 RT-PCR 检测甲型流感病毒,然后进行 H5/H7 亚型筛查。阳性样本接受了完整血凝素基因的牛津纳米孔测序和系统发育分析,以确定遗传谱系。
elements_zh.main_results: 604 个样本中的 30 个(4.97%)检测到甲型流感病毒 RNA,而所有样本的 H5 和 H7 亚型检测均为阴性。完整的血凝素测序鉴定出三种低致病性亚型(H1、H4 和 H6),它们聚集在与欧洲、亚洲和北美当代禽病毒密切相关的已建立的欧亚谱系中。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为低致病性甲型禽流感病毒在乌克兰候鸟中活跃传播的证据,为 监测 提供了基因组基线。他们强调了便携式纳米孔测序和集成 One Health 监测 在监测病毒多样性和早期威胁检测方面的实用性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果支持在乌克兰加强禽流感监测,特别是在黑海-地中海迁徙路线沿线,以便在“同一个健康”框架内为风险评估和新出现的流感威胁的早期发现提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其依赖于单季采样和地理限制区域,这可能会降低普遍性。由于缺乏家禽感染数据且缺乏纵向随访,证据强度中等。

title: Production-Type-Specific Spatial and Space–Time Clustering of High-Pathogenicity Avian Influenza Outbreaks in Layer and Duck Farms in the Republic of Korea, 2020–2026
abstract: High-pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI) remains a recurrent threat to poultry production in the Republic of Korea, but production-type-specific clustering has rarely been assessed against the underlying farm population. This retrospective unmatched case–control point-pattern study examined spatial and space–time clustering across six epidemic seasons from 2020 to 2026. We analyzed 486 reported poultry-farm outbreak records together with a national registry of 66,499 poultry farms. The principal analyses compared 204 layer and 204 duck outbreak events with farms of the same production type using the Cuzick–Edwards k-nearest-neighbor statistic, an observed-to-expected clustering-intensity ratio, kernel relative-risk mapping, and spatial and space–time scan statistics. At k = 5, the observed-to-expected intensity ratio was 2.51 for layer events and 1.63 for duck events; this between-type contrast was descriptive because no direct inferential test was performed. Layer-event clustering remained elevated across all seasons, although the extreme 2023–2024 estimate was based on only 15 events. Duck-event clustering was more intermittent and increased in 2025–2026. Premises-level scan statistics identified a broad layer cluster with a relative risk of 3.12 and a smaller duck cluster with a higher local relative risk but far fewer farms. A layer space–time cluster occurred in 2024–2025. These findings support production-type-specific, density-aware surveillance. They do not establish farm-to-farm transmission or implicate egg-handling infrastructure, and they should be interpreted in light of the static registry, repeated-event design, and unmeasured flock size, movements, biosecurity, environmental exposure, and viral lineage.

title: Socioeconomic differences in influenza vaccination coverage by government financial support status: A population-based study in Korea
abstract: BACKGROUND: Influenza can be prevented through vaccination, however vaccination coverage remains low. This study aims to analyze whether government financial support policies associated with improved vaccination coverage and to further analyze other influencing socioeconomic factors. METHODS: This study utilized secondary data from the 2020 Korea National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey to analyze factors influencing influenza vaccination among 5,592 participants. Multivariate logistic regression analysis was used to analyze the association between government financial support and vaccination coverage, and to analyze socioeconomic factors influencing vaccination in both the government-supported and non-supported groups. RESULTS: The vaccination rate was higher in the financial-supported group(63.8%) than in the non-supported group(33.1%). After adjustment, the financial assistance group had a 2.02 higher vaccination coverage compared to the non-supported group. In the financial-supported group, low education and economic inactivity were associated with higher vaccination rates. While, in the non-supported group, women, higher household-income, and having employee-insured subscribers were associated with vaccination coverage. CONCLUSIONS: Financial support is provided to high-risk groups for influenza infection, and this group showed higher vaccination coverage in low socioeconomic groups. Therefore, targeted government intervention appears necessary to improve vaccination coverage in high-risk groups.

abstract_zh: 背景:可以通过 疫苗接种 预防流感,但 疫苗接种 的覆盖率仍然较低。本研究旨在分析政府财政支持政策是否与提高疫苗接种覆盖率相关,并进一步分析其他影响社会经济因素。方法:本研究利用 2020 年韩国国家健康和营养检查调查的二手数据,分析了 5,592 名参与者中影响流感 疫苗接种 的因素。采用多元logistic回归分析方法分析政府财政支持与疫苗接种覆盖率之间的关联,并分析政府支持和非支持群体中影响疫苗接种的社会经济因素。结果:经济资助组的疫苗接种率(63.8%)高于非资助组(33.1%)。调整后,经济援助组的 疫苗接种 覆盖范围比非资助组高 2.02。在财政支持组中,低教育程度和经济不活跃与较高的 疫苗接种 率相关。而在不受支持的群体中,女性、较高的家庭收入以及拥有员工保险的订户与 疫苗接种 保险范围相关。结论:为流感感染高危群体提供了财政支持,该群体在低社会经济群体中表现出较高的 疫苗接种 覆盖率。因此,有必要进行有针对性的政府干预,以提高高危人群的 疫苗接种 覆盖率。

title: Influenza-Associated Cardiac Manifestations: A Systematic Review of Case Reports and Case Series
abstract: Background: Influenza is primarily a respiratory illness, but it is increasingly linked to acute cardiovascular complications, including myocarditis and sudden cardiac death. Evidence on influenza-associated cardiac involvement remains fragmented and largely derived from case-based reports. Methods: This systematic review followed PRISMA guidelines and was registered with PROSPERO (CRD420251249130). PubMed, Web of Science, and Google Scholar were searched for eligible studies. Case reports and case series were included to characterize rare, severe, or atypical cardiac manifestations that are not captured in larger epidemiological studies. Data on demographics, influenza subtype, cardiac manifestations, investigations, management, and outcomes were extracted. Results: Thirty-three studies (32 case reports and one case series) comprising 36 cases were included. Influenza A was reported in 26 cases and influenza B was reported in 9 cases. Myocarditis was the most common manifestation (19 cases, 53%), including fulminant myocarditis in 9 cases (25%). Cardiogenic shock occurred in seven cases (19%), malignant arrhythmias in four(11%), myocardial infarction–like presentations in three (8%), and cardiac arrest or sudden cardiac death in six cases (17%). Cardiac involvement occurred across all age groups, frequently in patients without pre-existing coronary artery disease. Overall mortality was 44% (16/36), with fatalities reported in both influenza A and B infections. These findings predominantly reflect severe and published cases and may not represent the full clinical spectrum of influenza-associated cardiac involvement. Conclusions: This review highlights that influenza infection has been reported in association with a range of acute cardiac manifestations, particularly myocarditis, including severe and fulminant presentations. However, given the reliance on case reports and case series, the findings are subject to significant publication bias and do not permit the estimation of incidence, risk, or causal inference. These observations should therefore be interpreted as hypothesis-generating.
